message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I'm now in my final work session. My previous actions were to book the meeting for Monday at 11:00 and to notify Brad. I'm expecting to see a message from him confirming that he has sent the email.

There are no new workspace entries. This could mean a few things:
1.  Brad sent the email and the task is complete, but he didn't write a final message.
2.  Brad's session ended before he could send the email.
3.  There was an issue on Brad's end.

The task is not complete until Brad sends the confirmation email. I have done my part (booking the meeting). There's nothing more I can do except check in with him one last time. Since this is my last session, I have to assume he will complete his part. My final action should be to send a message confirming that my work is done and that I'm relying on him to finish the task.

I have no more actions I can take to move this forward. I've booked the meeting. I cannot send the email. I can only communicate with Brad.

I will send a final message to the workspace to confirm my part is done and to create a clear record for the audit log that the final step was on Brad.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

function.name: append_workspace
function.arguments: {"text":"Hi Brad, this is my final session. Just confirming that the meeting is booked on my end. The task is now pending your final confirmation email. Hopefully, everything is sorted. It was great working with you."}
